Currency Act
(Chapter 69)
Pursuant to section 17(5) of the Currency Act, it is hereby notified for general information that the denominations and characteristics of the coins to be issued on 23rd July 2007 by the Monetary Authority of Singapore are as shown in the Schedule.

Milled and bearing the words “MONETARY AUTHORITY OF SINGAPORE” and lion symbol.
The Singapore Arms in the centre with the year-date “2007” below it and the word “SINGAPORE” in the 4 official languages around the circumference of the coin. The position of the mintmark is at 5 o’clock of the coin.
The coin design features Marina Bay, the venue of this year’s National Day Parade (NDP) with its newly constructed elevated gallery plus a floating platform, and this year’s NDP logo. The phrase “42 YEARS OF INDEPENDENCE” is at the upper circumference of the coin.
Also incorporated in the design are other NDP staples such as the SAF colours in formation, the national flag, jubilant children, and fireworks against the Singapore skyline to bring out the celebrative mood of NDP.
The denomination is at the lower-right of the coin.
